archipel_azur.title: The Azure Archipelago
archipel_azur.story: Here, the waves bring back fragments of sky. Beneath the palms, they say a seashell lets you hear the sea of your next journey.

cimes_eternelles.title: The Eternal Peaks
cimes_eternelles.story: On these peaks, the wind never stops singing. A little bell gathers its melody and shares it with travellers when everything falls silent.

mycelia.title: Mycelia
mycelia.story: At dusk, the mushrooms light their windows. Their spores illuminate the paths, so even lost travellers can find a welcoming door.

ruines_englouties.title: The Sunken Ruins
ruines_englouties.story: The sea has kept the doors of this ancient city open. Between its columns, a mother-of-pearl key waits for a former resident to return and open their door.

coeur_de_braise.title: The Ember Heart
coeur_de_braise.story: Beneath the dark stone, the world keeps a glowing heart. Each drifting ember carries a little of its warmth to lands where winter lingers.

iles_suspendues.title: The Hanging Isles
iles_suspendues.story: The islands drift without ever losing sight of one another. Their inhabitants tie a weightless pebble to each letter: it always finds the breeze that leads to a friend.

marais_des_lucioles.title: The Firefly Marsh
marais_des_lucioles.story: At nightfall, a thousand lights trace a path across the water. Travellers take home a little empty lantern: the fireflies prefer to stay free.

desert_de_cristal.title: The Crystal Desert
desert_de_cristal.story: In the sunlight, the dunes chime like glass. Here, an hourglass measures something other than hours: the time it takes to find wonder again.

palais_de_givre.title: The Frost Palace
palais_de_givre.story: Each winter, the palace builds itself another room. A frost rose waits on the doorstep; in a guest’s hand, it never melts.

temple_oublie.title: The Forgotten Temple
temple_oublie.story: Roots have replaced the steps, but the temple welcomes those who tread lightly. A wooden amulet holds the memory of everyone who has rested here.

ile_des_cendres.title: The Ashen Island
ile_des_cendres.story: Ash falls here as softly as snow. Beneath the dark palms, a red seed waits for the first rain to begin the world anew.

grottes_sporiferes.title: The Spore Caverns
grottes_sporiferes.story: Beneath the mountain, spores draw an upside-down sky. Travellers gather a geode whose light can soften even the longest night.

canopee_des_brumes.title: The Mist Canopy
canopee_des_brumes.story: The branches hold the clouds long enough for them to dream. In a leaf cup, a drop of mist holds the morning freshness in suspension.

recif_de_verre.title: The Glass Reef
recif_de_verre.story: The glass corals change colour with the tide. One pearl keeps all their reflections, even far from the ocean.

jardins_du_zenith.title: The Zenith Gardens
jardins_du_zenith.story: At noon, the gardens float in golden light. Their gardeners lend watering cans to the clouds, who always remember to bring them back full.

cite_immobile.title: The Still City
cite_immobile.story: Snow has stopped the clocks without dimming the windows. A watch without hands is a reminder that here, nobody is ever late.

sylve_prismatique.title: The Prismwood
sylve_prismatique.story: In this forest, every leaf chooses its own colour. A prism hanging from a branch offers a little rainbow to anyone who takes time to look.

necropole_ardente.title: The Ember Necropolis
necropole_ardente.story: Flames watch over names that time has worn away. An ancient lamp keeps their quiet warmth alive, like a thought for those who are missed.

foret_du_silence.title: The Silent Forest
foret_du_silence.story: Snow wraps the trees and muffles the sounds of the world. A white feather rests on a stump, so light it seems to float in the silence.

sanctuaire_des_spores.title: The Spore Sanctuary
sanctuaire_des_spores.story: In the alcoves, spheres gather the mushrooms’ golden spores. A medallion holds a few of them, their gentle light accompanying the traveller.

royaume_des_spores_celestes.title: The Skyspore Kingdom
royaume_des_spores_celestes.story: Weightless mushrooms travel from cloud to cloud. Their little parasols do not keep out the rain: they teach dreams to fly.

tempete_ecarlate.title: The Scarlet Storm
tempete_ecarlate.story: The red clouds tell each other their troubles in flashes of lightning. When they fall quiet, a spark sometimes remains, warm and gentle inside a tiny bottle.

atoll_boreal.title: The Boreal Atoll
atoll_boreal.story: The palms wear fringes of snow beneath the aurora. A bracelet woven from light keeps the colours of this impossible night around your wrist.

vestiges_celestes.title: The Celestial Remains
vestiges_celestes.story: The stairways still climb, even where the palaces have vanished. A mosaic fragment shows a star: perhaps the address of those who once lived here.

mer_figee.title: The Frozen Sea
mer_figee.story: A wave stopped just before reaching the shore. Inside a little glass globe, its sea foam still dances.

jungle_incandescente.title: The Glowing Jungle
jungle_incandescente.story: The vines glow without burning and flowers open in the warmth. A lantern fruit guides travellers to the forest’s edge, then remembers their path.

jardins_de_gemmes.title: The Gem Gardens
jardins_de_gemmes.story: The gardeners water their mushrooms with moonlight. By morning, a gem flower has grown: it needs neither water nor a vase, only a little light.

empire_des_sables.title: The Sand Empire
empire_des_sables.story: The dunes move the streets while the city sleeps. A little lamp always points towards the oasis, even when every road has changed.

faille_des_contraires.title: The Rift of Opposites
faille_des_contraires.story: Embers on one side, frost on the other. Above the rift, two knotted ribbons stay warm: sometimes opposites know how to keep each other cosy.

observatoire_des_etoiles.title: The Star Observatory
observatoire_des_etoiles.story: Here, the stars come down low enough to look through the telescopes. A pocket lens keeps a patch of sky for evenings when clouds hide everything.

tutorial.title: A few words before you travel
tutorial.departure: Choose two elements to guide the compass. Each pairing leads to a world… or the Void.
tutorial.exploration: Some worlds hide a souvenir. Look closely, touch… the landscape may respond. You can leave and come back later.
tutorial.souvenir: A souvenir joins your journal. Some will give you a reason to travel again… Find the journal at the bottom left of the map.
